projects.title: PersistentObjectStorage
bullets: Built a Java library for persisting objects to a per-user folder, including first-run detection logic.
Added an automated test suite after an edge case in first-run detection surfaced during manual testing.

projects.title: FileHashComparator
bullets: Wrote a Swift command-line tool that generates file hashes and compares them to flag differences.
Organized the 15-file project to separate hashing from comparison logic, aiding manual verification.

leadership.title: Peer Debugging Volunteer
bullets: Noticed peers' bug reports often lacked steps to reproduce failures, making issues hard to confirm.
Introduced a short reporting checklist covering environment, steps, and expected versus actual behavior.
Found that clearer reports cut back-and-forth with peers, and started writing tests instead of one-off fixes.
